title: Eight-Bed Ultra Luxury HMO
desc: An eight-bedroom ultra luxury HMO on the south coast, built around a rooflit living and dining space at the back of the house.

listing.provenance: By HMO Designers, part of Thistle Group

writeup.approach: The communal heart of the house is a rear living and dining room lit by a large flush rooflight, with French doors to the outside. The finish is pitched well above the standard letting specification: wall lights either side of a sculptural panel, cane and black timber dining chairs, and a soft palette that reads as a home rather than a room let by the week.
writeup.outcome: Complete and let. HMO Designers worked as part of the wider project team on this scheme rather than as sole designer, so the credit is shared with the others involved.
